summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors resolved to partially reverse an Optional Reserve for Dividend Payment, releasing ARS 247,344,290,288 of undistributed realized and liquid earnings from January 1, 2025, equal to ARS 164.00 per share in cash. Record date is September 18, 2026, with payment on September 25, 2026, via Caja de Valores. Foreign holders may elect U.S. dollar collection abroad during a September 21-22, 2026 window, subject to central bank FX access; a 7% withholding applies where relevant. The board recommends payment; no advisor named. Watch FX access and withholding leakage.
